implementedObservationConstraint.scope: Source-defined GWI mathematical kernel, dependency-ready; not a completed calibrated ensemble, not a physical spatial mixing operator or arbitrary GSAT-to-GMST factor
implementedObservationConstraint.equation: For each separately simulated GHG/Nat/OHF forcing-response fingerprint member X, observation member O and control slice P: beta=lstsq(X,O)+lstsq(X,P), no intercept; attributed component=X_component*beta_component; human=GHG+OHF, total=human+Nat
implementedObservationConstraint.modelBaseline: Separate 1850-1900 inclusive (51-year) mean for each model fingerprint before regression
implementedObservationConstraint.observationBaseline: One common mean of the ensemble median over 1850-1900 inclusive; never individually erase observation-member baseline uncertainty
implementedObservationConstraint.controlBaselineExecutable: Operative load_PiC_CMIP6 subtracts each source slice's first end_pi-start_pi=50 positions. This differs from the nominal 51-year model/observation period. The kernel preserves and reports that executable distinction rather than silently correcting the source.
implementedObservationConstraint.controlFiltering: Exact strict source limits: valid 3-year smoothed max<0.3, min>-0.3, span>0.06; valid 30-year smoothed max<0.1 and min>-0.1
implementedObservationConstraint.jointIdentity: Fingerprint, observation and control identities retained separately, with explicit coefficient dimensions; no marginal-quantile reconstruction
implementedObservationConstraint.safety: Reject missing full 1850-2025 years, duplicated identities, nonfinite inputs, total-temperature proxies and rank-deficient fingerprints. Require explicit batch implementation above 100000 combinations; do not accidentally attempt the source's multi-million-member job.
implementedObservationConstraint.notAppliedToExistingPairedSSPSeries: Those are one nonlinear emissions-intervention contrast, not independent GHG/OHF/Nat response fingerprints or an observation-constrained GWI ensemble. Regressing that vector and relabelling it human GMST would not reproduce the source.
